links.outcome: Proportion of physicians with formal AI training; association of training with AI use
links.effect: 17.7% had received formal training; 27.8% had used AI in practice. Trained physicians were >3 times as likely to use AI (adjusted OR 3.40; 95% CI 2.31-5.01).
links.quote: However, only 27.8% had used AI in practice, and 17.7% had received formal training.

unlisted_practices: Institutional investment in AI technologies as a driver of physician adoption (adjusted OR 8.43 for working in institutions with AI technologies)

screen.reason: An international survey of over 1,000 physicians evaluating real-world AI use in practice, examining the impact of formal training and institutional technology presence on adoption.
